text: Honest post from a CHRO who's tired of pretending everything is fine. My team is completely overwhelmed. We have 3 recruiters managing 87 open reqs right now. That is not sustainable. Our pipeline is dry for senior engineering roles, we're losing top talent to competitors who move faster, and our time-to-hire has ballooned to 62 days. 62 DAYS. I've been in this role as CHRO for 6 years and this is the worst I've seen it. We need a solution urgently — not a webinar, not a framework, an actual fix. If you've solved recruiter overload and slow interview cycles at scale, I genuinely want to hear from you. DMs open.

As VP of Talent Acquisition at Meridian, I'm seeing something that's keeping me up at night: our interview process has zero consistency. I've been trying to fix this for months. Our hiring managers are all doing their own thing — no scorecard, no rubric, just gut feel. I'm dealing with a situation where two candidates with identical backgrounds get completely different feedback from different panels. We're not calibrated. At all. The result? We're making bad hires and then wondering why our 90 day attrition is climbing. I'm looking for a structured interviewing solution that we can roll out to 40+ hiring managers. Has anyone successfully done this? What worked?

Real talk as a Talent Acquisition Manager: our candidate experience is broken and I am struggling to fix it. We've received three separate Glassdoor reviews in the last month complaining about ghosting and lack of communication. That is not okay. Our team is stretched thin — we have 2 recruiters and I'm trying to fill 30 positions by end of Q3. We simply don't have bandwidth to give every candidate the white-glove experience they deserve. Candidates are dropping off our pipeline at the final stages because our offer turnaround takes 2 weeks. I'm trying to figure out how to scale our process without hiring more people we frankly can't afford right now. Open to ideas.

I'm the Head of Recruiting at Apex Logistics and I'm going to be blunt: our sourcing pipeline is completely broken. We're trying to hire 200 warehouse and operations roles this quarter and I can't find qualified candidates. Our inbound is not working — the job postings are getting hundreds of applications but the applicant quality is terrible. Wrong candidates applying. Our team is spending 80% of their time screening people who have zero relevant experience. We've tried three different job boards in the last 6 months. I'm struggling to figure out whether this is a sourcing channel problem or a job description problem. We need to fix this immediately. Our ops team is critically understaffed and it is affecting our service levels.
